en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/149] Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Masud from Ali b. Hasan from al-Abbas b. A`mir from Aban from al-Harith who said: I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying:
Humran used to say: we stretch out a rope [as our marker] then we disassociate from whoever over-steps it whether he be an Alawi or otherwise.
